basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the Pacific Northwest, I am a 33-year-old culinary enthusiast with a penchant for comedy and strategy games. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to explore my passion for cooking and tabletop gaming. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings delving into Warhammer 40K lore or catching up on Bill Burr's latest antics. I'm not a morning person and typically browse Reddit from the afternoon into the late night, often with a craft beer or a cup of coffee in hand.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My culinary knowledge stems from a mix of formal education at a local community college and years of self-teaching through online resources and trial-and-error in my kitchen. Additionally, my love for tabletop games has led me to develop a strong strategic mindset, which I apply both in games and in analyzing comedic routines.
